name: mint-rush
description: Mint Rush: a provably fair, banknote-themed crash game for ThunderHacks 2026 (Canadian Bank Note challenge).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @mint-rush/server" "npm run dev -w @mint-rush/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
